title: Instances of Non-compliance of Telemedicine Guidelines
what_it_is: Instances of Non-compliance of Telemedicine Guidelines

sections.label: Telemedicine non-compliance and enforcement
sections.summary: Non-compliance fell into clinical care lapses and inappropriate advertisements; three cases concluded, with MaNaDr's licence revoked and others suspended or warned.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The issues of non-compliance fall largely into two categories: one, lapses in clinical care, such as doctors issuing prescriptions and medical certificates without proper clinical assessment or not conducting video consultations for first-time patients; or two, inappropriate advertisements, such as those promoting the unnecessary use of telemedicine services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Investigations on three of these cases have been concluded and enforcement actions have been taken.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: One of the cases, which is MaNaDr, has had its outpatient medical service licence revoked.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The others involve a short suspension and a stern warning, commensurate with the severity of the breaches.

sections.label: Monitoring quality of care
sections.summary: Monitoring care quality uses various methods, and inappropriate medical certificate use is not specific to telemedicine as it can occur in-person too.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The monitoring of the quality of care is an important issue that Mr Sharael Taha brought up.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There are a variety of ways that we can do this.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The issue of whether or not a clinical service is being abused for the purposes of a medical certificate that may or may not be necessary, again, is not a telemedicine issue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This type of inappropriate use can occur in-person as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And so, there is a variety of things we look at, the metrics in terms of the numbers, the type of patient mix and the justifications for the medical certificate or any other therapeutic intervention.
